content: RLS fails silently: denied query returns empty result not an error, so overly strict policy looks like a data bug and overly permissive policy leaks data with no warning. Table with RLS enabled but zero policies = locked for everyone including owner. Common root cause of real breaches (CVE-2025-48757, Lovable incident Jan 2025, 170+ apps) is RLS simply not enabled on table creation, exposing data via anon key. Must test SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE separately and from multiple user accounts, not just SELECT.
